title: Design: Implicit slot renewal via TX activity
description:
Future enhancement beyond the max-duration cap:

Slots held implicitly instead of explicit expiry claims:
- Granted on first valid claim
- Renewed automatically each time node TXes in its slot
- Revoked after M consecutive missed TXes (e.g. 3-5 superframes)

Squatter must burn real airtime to hold slot. No renewal message overhead for active nodes.

Larger protocol change - max-duration cap is the quick fix, this is proper long-term.

Ref: project-LICHEN-worker6-70p7
